en.title: Software Developer
en.description:
Working on RISE, an internal business platform built as a React + TypeScript micro-frontend monorepo with an ASP.NET Core backend (Clean Architecture / DDD), Azure Functions and Azure DevOps CI/CD.

• DWork — a CRM for managing client accounts, consultants, interactions, needs and consultant availability, with real-time notifications. Includes a V2 rewrite with a feature-based architecture using React 19, Material UI and TanStack Query.
• DAF — an HR administration module covering the employee onboarding pipeline (candidate admission, document collection, contract generation with DocuSign signing), contract amendments and terminations.
• Project Estimation — a financial simulation tool for consulting engagements that calculates compensation, fees and costs, generates PDF proposals and emails them to candidates with GDPR consent and identity verification.
• Also contributed to User Management, with organisation charts and hierarchies.
